mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private payrolls exceeding 100k and a decline in retail sales exceeding 0.5% signals unsustainable labor market expansion without consumer support, triggering Fed tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases by >100k and RSAFS decreases by >0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime, a decline in industrial production signals an economic slowdown that prompts Fed policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and INDPRO declines by at least 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a weakening construction sector and reduced consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where HOUST falls below 1000 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales over the past three months indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In an economic expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), a decline in industrial production signals an early manufacturing slowdown, prompting Fed policy easing and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2.0% and INDPRO declines by at least 0.5%.
